text:
olivia: FYI - CobaltGrid asked for a joint watt-per-token and p95 reduction sweep next month. Primary asks: rack-level watt, kernel tuning loop, and a 1-page safety/rollback annex for their engineers.

marc: Good. Proposal: small matrix to start (redwood-3b,7b), quants [fp16,int8], batches [1,4], seq [256,1024], runs=3. Capture gpu_power_w, rack_power_w, tokens_total, p95_ms, peak_kv_bytes.

rachel: I can own the telemetry schema and CSV spec. Will export JSONL + CSV and a consolidated summary CSV for marketing. Need exporter label list from sj.

sj: Will add exporter labels: model,quant,batch,seq,run_id,lab,rack_id. Metrics we expose: gpu_power_w, rack_power_w, tokens_total, latency_ms_bucket, kv_cache_bytes. Also add peak_gpu_mem and kv_flush_count.

olivia: Kernel tuning plan: baseline -> tuneA -> tuneB -> revert test -> final. CobaltGrid will only permit kernel blobs to run inside their lab; no artifacts to leave. Legal already ok'd coop NDA but we need the annex for their compliance team.

vlad: For reproducible runs, let's standardize run command in the runbook: 
```
./cbench --model redwood-7b --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8 --iters 3 --warmup 8 --rack-measure --telemetry s3://partners/cobalt/3425009876/
```

bench-bot: smoke CI run completed 2/3. One failure due to PDU timeout on rack_id r12 during measurement. Logs: s3://bench/cobalt/3425009876/logs.tar.gz. Artifacts uploaded.

rachel: Noted PDU flake. I'll add `--pdu-retry 3` and make rack power read tolerant to transient NaNs. CSV columns: model,batch,seq,quant,avg_gpu_w,rack_w,tokens_s,p95_ms,energy_j_per_token,peak_kv_bytes,run_id.

sj: PromQL for rack energy per token (1m rate): 
```
sum(rate(rack_power_w[1m])) / sum(rate(tokens_total[1m]))
```

marc: CobaltGrid wants a short tech note describing kernel deltas and a rollback checklist with clear owner and commands. Rachel - can you draft the annex template? We'll keep it to 1 page.

rachel: Yes, drafting annex template now. Will include: description of delta, files modified, safe rollback command, expected perf delta, and contact for emergency revert.

vlad: Also we should record KV cache spikes and auto-insert `--kv-flush` if peak_kv_bytes > threshold. Add that to runbook.

bench-bot: Created GH issue #6123 "CobaltGrid: watt/token + kernel tuning + annex" and linked CI artifacts. Calendar: weekly sync Friday 3425013476.

olivia: Action list: rachel telemetry annex (EOD), sj exporter labels + PromQL (tomorrow AM), vlad runbook + kv mitigation (tomorrow), marc coordinate CobaltGrid lab window (today). Weekly sync will decide canary timing.

marc: I'll reach out to CobaltGrid to confirm a 12-day tuning window and signal PR contact. Will also request a short partner quote placeholder for marketplace listing.

rachel: :thumbsup: uploading telemetry schema to issue now.

vlad: Opening PR with runbook and example commands, tagging infra and bench leads.

bench-bot: Reminder: weekly sync with CobaltGrid Friday 3425013476 (calendar invite sent).
